frontmatter.name: wear-compose-m3
frontmatter.description: Guidance for Wear OS Compose Material3 (Wear Compose Material 3 / Wear Compose Material3) Android watch and wearable apps. Covers creating, updating, and migrating projects (Material 2.5 and Horologist migration) using androidx.wear.compose.material3, androidx.wear.compose.foundation, and androidx.wear.compose.navigation3, including AppScaffold, ScreenScaffold, TransformingLazyColumn, one-handed gestures, ambient mode, and previews. Don't use for mobile, tablet, or TV Compose apps.
